method: Compared all 23 manifested artifact/input hashes against current bytes; reread revised synthesis, first slice, needs, all task cards, proposals and 39 advocate traces; checked prior blockers, explicit deferrals and pending human gates. Ran the research integrity helper without treating its pass as customer or source validation.
findings_disposition: B01 repaired: option exploration/selection/analysis/reversible play is the first slice, with commercial unknowns retained as a boundary.

B02 repaired or explicitly deferred: reliability, computed recovery and local stay/per-gap/return needs have substantive tests; country avoidance, group aggregation and export rights have X01-X03 deferrals.
B03 repaired: flight/journey scope, comparison pins/tradeoffs, filtered context, progressive depth and preview/apply consequences are explicit experiments.
B04 repaired: unprompted customer prompts are separate from prescribed QA actions; T05/T06 identity truth is action-specific.
Q01-Q10 accept the research plan only; no remaining blocking contradiction within the reviewed scope.
limitations: No participants, customer observations, usability results or human approval.
No final default/layout choice, accessibility conformance or public-readiness approval.
No independent rerun of historical product tests or source claims outside the advocate's recorded checks.
Additional truth fixtures and actual comparative/inclusive sessions remain pending before experiment success claims.
All 84 needs remain hypotheses; source links and owner intent do not establish demand or prevalence.
Real provider coverage/rights, personal transfer feasibility and commercial facts remain unknown.
